_README: Seed list for the model_dep tag — which foundation-model FAMILY
each app is built on. Family slugs match what the auto-detector
'qwen', 'grok'), so manual entries here and auto-detected ones
produce consistent 'Built on Claude' chips on agent pages.
Format: { '<agent slug>': ['<family>', ...] }. An agent can be
tagged with multiple families — Cursor speaks Claude AND GPT.
Tag chip on an agent's page links to /sectors/model_dep/<family>
which lists every app with that family tag.
